purpose: Phase 0 reference targets for repeatable compatibility, accessibility, offline, and performance evidence

supportPolicy.note: A listed target is not supported or verified until its checklist gate has execution evidence. Public OS/browser support remains provisional until STG-004 and the STG-008 decision record.

targetPriority.required: Required evidence before the applicable release or platform gate can close.
targetPriority.supplemental: Useful compatibility or stress evidence that cannot substitute for a required row.
targetPriority.diagnostic: Available for fast feedback only; never a release or performance gate.

availability.available: A conforming target is provisioned and its exact environment can be recorded in a result manifest.
availability.available-diagnostic: Present on the current development workstation but not a conforming reference lane.
availability.planned: The target is defined but its runner/device has not been provisioned and verified.
availability.unavailable: No conforming environment is currently available.

verification.not-executed: No result manifest exists; this is not a pass.
verification.passed: A result manifest bound to a commit, lockfile, fixture set, and exact environment passed.
verification.failed: Execution evidence exists and one or more required assertions failed.

versionPolicy.patch: Correct source or patch-version metadata without changing coverage or a budget.
versionPolicy.minor: Add a compatible target, scenario, or measurement field.
versionPolicy.major: Remove a target, change a browser/OS floor, or change a performance budget; review the decision register and create an ADR when an Accepted decision is affected.

resultManifestRequiredFields: fixture ID, seed, and fixture SHA-256
exact OS, browser/webview, assistive-technology, and app-build versions
raw artifact paths, summary statistics, failures, and reviewer
privacyAndIsolation: Use only synthetic or licensed fixtures in automated, previous-browser, extension, and shared-runner lanes.
Use an isolated browser profile and a local test origin.
Never place real resumes, application answers, provider keys, cookies, or career records in test artifacts.
